instructions: Cut the bell pepper into thin strips and the cucumber into thin sticks about as long as the tortilla is wide. Chop the tomatoes, then pat them dry with a paper towel.
Thinly slice 1/2 cup of the red cabbage. Peel 1 carrot and slice it into thin sticks. That should be about 1/2 cup.
Lay a tortilla flat. Spread 1/4 cup of the hummus down the middle, leaving about 2 inches clear at each end.
Layer a quarter of the spinach, pepper, cucumber, tomato, cabbage and carrot over the hummus. Keep the filling in a neat line so the wrap rolls cleanly.
Fold in the two ends, then roll the wrap up tightly from the bottom. Make the other 3 wraps the same way.
Cut each wrap in half. For a packed lunch, wrap each one tightly in foil and keep it in the fridge. Eat them within 2 days.
method_notes: Karissa's Vegan Kitchen is the lead (5 out of 5, but only 5 votes), so this is a fallback lead. Elizabeth Rider, America's Test Kitchen and Simple Veganista all spread hummus on a wrap and roll raw vegetables in it. They differ in the vegetables and in what goes with it: a vinaigrette in two of them, avocado and sprouts in two. This follows Karissa's vegetables and plain build with no dressing. Sources disagree on keeping: same day to 3 days, so the shorter 2 days is written, and the tomato is patted dry to help.
